The pace is quick, and the taiko drumming is foreboding and tribal, but the airy beauty of the chords is almost calming.

pieces.title: Devastation and Revenge
pieces.instruments: Synths, Percussion, Strings, Brass, Guitar, Voice
pieces.description: A low hum sets a dark and mysterious mood, but at 0:49 the orchestral strings, horns, and pounding drums begin, perfect as the background to the hero?s dilemma or impending battle scene. At 2:01 the music reaches a climax and builds into discordant, terrifying suspense. The ending, at 2:35, features a lone guitar and mournful vocals, depicting a great sadness and loss.
pieces.feel: Eerie, Epic, Intense, Mystical, Somber, Suspenseful

pieces.title: Finding Movement
pieces.description: The koto in this piece follows a steady, plodding beat, while the orchestral strings provide a drone-like background. At 0:33 the strings crescendo to follow the melody of the koto, but at 1:18 the tempo slows and the strings fade away, only to return to highlight the final chord.  With the even rhythm and the sharply accentuated plucks of the koto, this is best used as an introduction to a short film or game, or the resolution to a conflict surrounding family or challenges to tradition.

pieces.title: Ripples
pieces.description: Flowing like water, this serene piece is perfect for relaxation and meditation. The solitary plucks of the Chinese guzheng reverberate slightly, and maintain a steadiness that would work well for introspective, Asian-themed content. This would also work well for anything depicting snow, winter, or Rural Japan.

pieces.title: Prelude in C (BWV 846)
pieces.description: J. S. Bach. This is the famous first piece of the Well Tempered Clavier, Book 1. Performed on piano. Very clean recording.

pieces.title: Song of the Volga Boatmen
pieces.description: Yo, Heave Ho! The classic theme of difficult drudgery. Based on a Russian folk song.

pieces.title: Chee Zee Cave
pieces.description: Loping dissonant loopable atmospheric.

pieces.title: Consort for Brass
pieces.description: A stately brass choir set in a cathedral.

pieces.title: Nu Flute
pieces.description: Eastern flute-like reed-like instrument - the Dizi.

pieces.title: New Direction
pieces.description: A calm ambient piece using the "Trope" synth for iPhone and some miscellaneous Logic synths.

pieces.title: Ranz des Vaches
pieces.description: Ranz des Vaches or "Call to the Dairy Cows" is a small but famous section of the overture to William Tell by Rossini. It is most often used to depict morning or sleepiness in cartoons. Hook starts at 0:21.

pieces.title: Sinfonia Number 5
pieces.description: J. S. Bach's 3-part invention that I hacked together for music for a "stuffy aristocratic dinner party". Of all the Sinfonias, I think this works the best for that.

pieces.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Mermaid
pieces.instruments: Harps, Voice, Exotic Organ, Waterphone, Percussion, Glass Harmonica
pieces.description: Is she a mer-maid, or is she an illusion! Her enchanting voice will entice, and she is 100% alive! Keep your wits about you, gentlemen - you don't want to be dragged to an unfortunate end.  Very heavy on bass.
pieces.feel: Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Mystical, Relaxed, Suspenseful, Unnerving

pieces.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Snake Lady
pieces.description: One of the more sultry sideshow acts in the Tenebrous Brothers Carnival, The Snake Lady is a crowd favorite that most never forget, even if they don't remember exactly what happened during the show.

pieces.title: Ghostpocalypse - 1 Departure
pieces.description: 1 of 8 in Ghostpocalypse. 100% atmospheric. No melodic or rhythmic elements.

pieces.title: Ghostpocalypse - 2 The Call
pieces.description: 2 of 8. Some dark and low rhythmic elements. Some bits of piano.

pieces.title: Ghostpocalypse - 3 Road of Trials
pieces.description: 3 of 8. Odd phrasing and counterpoints.

pieces.title: Ghostpocalypse - 4 Temptress
pieces.description: 4 of 8. Driving slower rhythm with piano.

pieces.title: Ghostpocalypse - 6 Crossing the Threshold
pieces.description: 6 of 8. Waltz-like theme.

pieces.title: Ghostpocalypse - 8 Epilog
pieces.description: 8 of 8. Quirky little solo for 2 pianos and one player.

pieces.title: A Singular Perversion
pieces.description: Overplayed piano, subtle percussion, sweepy violins.

pieces.title: Dopplerette
pieces.description: Swift, abrupt ending.

pieces.title: Seventh Seal
pieces.description: Simple drone followed by a crescendo leading to silence.

pieces.title: Spacial Harvest
pieces.description: Deep unsettling piece with no repeated themes. Fat, rounded bass drone with very high pitched interest on top.

pieces.title: Spring Thaw
pieces.description: Simple melody. Something feels amiss here, but in a sort of pleasing way

pieces.title: Sunset at Glengorm
pieces.description: Processed piano is featured, leaving a deep uncertain texture. Tempo is highly variable.

pieces.title: Investigations
pieces.instruments: Pizzicato Strings, English Horn, Bassoon, Marimba, Glockenspiel, Cowbells
pieces.description: Sort of a loafing comedic piece for all of your amusing scenes with dialog that does not need to move the story. Also reasonable for scenes with no dialog.

pieces.title: Resignation
pieces.description: Short piece with a very quiet and rich piano part - the bass is barely audible, for low-end support.

pieces.title: Sneaky Adventure
pieces.description: Tight pizz string section, joined by a lone bassoon on the recapitulation.

pieces.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act One
pieces.instruments: Organ, Percussion, Glockenspiel, Voice, Clarinet, Strings, Tuba
pieces.description: This peculiar piece does have a story. If anyone would like to animate it, you'll have to bring your own script. Moderately large changes every minute or so. Accelerando at the end.

pieces.title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Prelude
pieces.description: Originally released in a special collection as "Delayed Due to Dissonance", this piece is not part of a larger arc.

pieces.title: The Parting
pieces.instruments: Oboe, Flute, Strings, Trombones, Horn, Tuba
pieces.description: I wrote this one December 27th, 2009 mainly for fun. It is a sweeping quiet piece until the past bit where is opens up a bit.  At 2:06, there is an oddly supported line with a 2+ octave gap between the melody and the supporting bass. At 2:28, the gap is filled triumphantly... It ends with a hollow dominant in 5 octaves, followed by a lush resolution.

pieces.title: Thinking of You
pieces.description: Nice piece for a narrative voice-over of good times past, present or future.

pieces.title: Harlequin
pieces.description: Quirky little duet. Major contrast between a staccato piano line, and the sweeping long bass clarinet.

pieces.title: Hypnothis
pieces.description: Sweet chill electronic piece with a run of dissonances starting around 3 minutes in.

pieces.title: Shores of Avalon
pieces.description: Highly processed piano with lots of subtle synths and vocal effects. Grows in intensity after the 3 minute mark, then calms again.

pieces.title: Ambiment
pieces.description: Slow sonorous texture punctuated with soft piano in mostly consonant tones. There is enough dissonance to keep the mind engaged over its length.

pieces.title: Impact Andante
pieces.description: 2 of 6. This piece changes perspectives a few times, and stays very fresh throughout.

pieces.title: Impact Lento
pieces.description: 6 of 6. Very slow start. This piece uses warm but thin textures, and several striking chord progressions.

pieces.title: Impact Moderato
pieces.description: 3 of 6. Laid back drum kit with a lot of extra percussion under a simple guitar.

pieces.title: Impact Prelude
pieces.description: 1 of 6. Chill opening theme with lots of percussion bits.

pieces.title: Neo Western
pieces.description: Big drums and an exposed 'western-style' electric guitar. Lots of drums.

pieces.title: Tranquility Base
pieces.description: Super chill, meditative, and massively long drone. The preview is cut to three minutes, but the entire download is 18 minutes, and more than 42 meg. Please be patient.

pieces.title: Der Kleber Sting
pieces.description: Your standard "dun dun DUUUUN!" hit.

pieces.title: Last Kiss Goodnight
pieces.instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Strings, Piano
pieces.description: Classic 50's/60's I, iv, IV, V chord progression as in "Unchained Melody" or "Sleepwalk".

pieces.title: Nile's Blues
pieces.description: Slow blues in 6/8. Tasty.

pieces.title: Lamentation
pieces.description: Slow solo harp piece.

pieces.title: Symbiosis
pieces.description: Quiet solo piano in 3 parts with additional percussion bit adding in more and more to the end. My normal "feels" that are used to classify pieces are largely inadequate for this piece, as are the genres. In other words... I have no idea what this is.

pieces.title: Unpromised
pieces.description: Thin piece with surprising chordal structures in the second A section.

pieces.title: Disco Lounge
pieces.description: Umm... this is really hard to describe. Take a listen, you might need it. Easy chill disco. It has an "eye of the tiger"-ish synth line and a super cool vibe part. Drum kit is distressed in parts.

pieces.title: Kool Kats
pieces.description: A sort of simple lounge chill spy piece.

pieces.title: Birch Run
pieces.description: Native American drumming, sometimes with rattles. The 2 main drummers are funkier than most Native American pieces.

pieces.title: Firesong
pieces.description: Native American drumming with a deep dark drive. Slowly picks up in speed throughout.

pieces.title: Rising Game
pieces.instruments: Bass, Brass, Percussion, Choir, Guitar, Strings, Pipe Organ
pieces.description: Dark piece in 2 roughly equal main parts. Gets progressively more exciting.
pieces.feel: Dark, Driving, Epic, Grooving, Intense, Mysterious

pieces.title: Willow and the Light
pieces.description: Think dark overgrown forest with overtones of magic in it. This one can loop perfectly - if you cut it right.

pieces.title: Fast Talkin
pieces.description: Noir. Private detective from the 1940's sort of feel.

pieces.title: Long Road Ahead B
pieces.description: Same as "Long Road Ahead", but without the final triumphant section.

pieces.title: Long Road Ahead
pieces.description: Very simple folk melody. Like the aftermath of a battle between good and evil. Major triumphant section for the final third of the piece.

pieces.title: Private Reflection
pieces.description: Epic myth. Part of the hero's journey. Starts with a solo soprano, and later mixes a full choir. Ends assuming you'll mix it into another piece.
pieces.feel: Dark, Eerie, Epic, Intense, Somber, Unnerving

pieces.title: Wounded

pieces.title: Soporific

pieces.description: A calming meditative piece rendered on 4 iPhones using the Balls, Bloom, Bebot, and Ocarina applications.

pieces.title: Winter Reflections
pieces.description: A calming piece rendered on 3 iPhones using the Bloom, Bebot, and Balls applications.

pieces.title: Aftermath

pieces.title: One of Them

pieces.title: Blue Paint
pieces.description: Calm piano solo centered around a repeating Ab motive.  20 seconds before end the motive expands slightly with an added harmony.

pieces.title: Desert City

pieces.title: Ominous

pieces.title: The North

pieces.description: An interesting section of Danse Macabre from around measure 145. There is a particularly nice viola trill with ornament.

pieces.title: Smoother Move

pieces.description: An experimental piece, designed to emulate a keyboardist with her robot.  The piano player likes to play with the EP in this piece.  Take a listen to get the full effect.  EP used heavily throughout the entire piece.  Build at 1:02, percussion picks up with heavy, fast beats.

pieces.title: Comfortable Mystery 2
pieces.description: Gentle electric piano chords and descending arpeggi are featured in this calming piece.

pieces.title: Comfortable Mystery 3
pieces.description: Gentle Electric Piano with a descending arpeggiated motive. The ending gradually slows.

pieces.title: Comfortable Mystery 4
pieces.description: Gentle Electric Piano featuring light chords and a descending arpeggiated motive.

pieces.title: Dark Star
pieces.description: Dark Star is a orchestral fanfare featuring a rising motive led by the brass and strings.  The piece builds gradually and finishes with a full orchestral climax.

pieces.title: Greta Sting
pieces.description: A somber orchestral sting with a gentle rising motion.

pieces.title: Spider Eyes
pieces.description: Spider Eyes is an eerie soundscape created with distant high strings, dissonant non-percussive piano textures, and alternately tuned bells.  This piece features much sustain and space.

pieces.title: Vulcan
pieces.description: A mystical piece for Flutes, Bells, and Percussion.  Disjointed melodic flute in counterpoint with lower fluttery flutes, plodding  percussion, and shimmering bells. Same texture throughout piece.

pieces.title: Blue Feather
pieces.description: Somber Solo Piano, with repetitive  descending arpeggio motive.  Contains uplifting moments, but generally sparse and mysterious.
pieces.feel: Calming, Dark, Eerie, Mysterious, Relaxed, Somber, Unnerving

pieces.title: One Sly Move
pieces.instruments: Electric Piano, Drum Kit, Synths, Guitar
pieces.description: A slow, relaxed, electronic piece.  This piece heavily uses EP and Synths.  From 1:01 to 1:20 all goes silent except the EP.  Mainly a synth and EP piece, guitar and kit in the background.

pieces.title: On the Passing of Time
pieces.description: A slow somber piano piece. Small amount of reverb to the notes.  Ends early, last 20 seconds dedicated to a fadeout.

pieces.title: Frost Waltz
pieces.instruments: Celesta, Glockenspiel, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, French Horns
pieces.description: A calm buy mysterious composition that uses Glockenspiel and Celesta throughout.  French Horns and Bass intercede throughout to accompany the Glockenspiel and Celesta.  Violin and Viola in the background throughout the piece.

pieces.title: BlockMan
pieces.description: An eerie piece featuring synths.  Great for ambiance.  Starts light, gets progressively eerier and more mysterious.  Climaxes at the end, finishes with a single beat.

pieces.title: Decay
pieces.description: A very dark piece heavily featuring cymbal and bells.  Frequent Cymbal usage creates unnerving feeling.  3:08 prolonged trombone.  Lasts almost 30 seconds.  This piece is great for an eerie atmosphere.

pieces.title: Longing and Concern
pieces.instruments: French Horns, Trombones, Flute, Woodblock, Trumpet, Strings
pieces.description: This is a great calm piece, featuring horns in the beginning, moving to flute.  Piece ends with a short fanfare with the trumpet and strings.  Fanfare begins at 1:03.

pieces.title: Road to Hell
pieces.description: A slow dark piece featuring a piano, bass duet.  Begins with bass, then immediately piano comes in.  Piece has continuous bass with piano coming in and out.  Finishes with prolonged bass note.

pieces.title: Texture for Violincello and Pianoforte No. 2
pieces.filename: Texture for Violincello and Pianoforte No. 2.mp3
pieces.description: An interesting jumble of cello and some piano fused together to create an eerie and intense piece the likes of which no one has ever heard of...until now.

pieces.title: Cool Intro

pieces.description: A sound track piece with Kit and Trombones/French Horns throughout.  This piece includes sections from a public domain (librivox) reading of "The Second Coming."

pieces.title: DD Groove
pieces.description: Very laid-back piece that may be indicative of a loss, or possibly carelessness.

pieces.title: Hero Theme
pieces.description: A short, powerful theme with a bit of hope.

pieces.title: Piano Between
pieces.description: Just a light piano piece for linking scenes.

pieces.title: Dark Hallway (clean)

pieces.title: Backed Vibes (clean)
pieces.description: Cool background jazz sound.

pieces.description: So you're thinking of doing a revival tour, but you don't have a band to back up your inspirational speech? Good news, good news indeed. This piece starts very thin, and builds a couple of times.

pieces.title: Tea Roots
pieces.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Erhu, Organ, Guitar, Piano, Horns
pieces.description: Almost straight-up reggae, but with a chinese folk violin in it.

pieces.title: Classic Horror 2
pieces.description: 5/8 time gives this piano solo a really unsettling feel. It uses more of the range of the piano, and can be chopped up to suit scenes well.

pieces.title: Classic Horror 3
pieces.description: Alternate tuning is very apparent here, Deep voicing lends a very ominous quality. Sounds more like the mind of someone who is breaking.

pieces.title: Dark Walk

pieces.description: A fairly intense beginning with a small piano part I pulled from a thing I wrote last week (Trio for Piano Violin and Viola), followed by a very long section of not moving much.

pieces.description: Impromptu performed on a Steinway Model D tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone. This gives a very rich feel to the base chords, but leaves a couple of "wolf notes" in the gaps (most notably in the Ab). 2 minutes in, it lingers on the most out-of tune part of the scales.

pieces.title: Sovereign Quarter

In this piece, it gives an unerringly warm feel, as the notes that would be least in tune in this are never used.

pieces.description: Bizarre mix of orchestral setting with a power guitar and drum set.
